title: Cloud-Integrated Smart Nanomembrane Wearables for Remote Wireless Continuous Health Monitoring of Postpartum Women.
summary: Residual CNN maps scalogram images of PPG from MIMIC-I ABP/BP records to blood pressure; source describes 82 selected MIMIC subjects (also reports a held-out test and standards comparison) and a separate month-long postpartum wearable study. Narrow claim: validated research model/platform, not proven clinical outcomes.
